[P2] Curaçao
Curaçao ( [ ` kʊrəsaʊ ] or [ ˈkjʊərəsaʊ ] ; Curaçao , [ kyːraːˈsʌu̯ ] ; Papiamentu : Kòrsou ) is a Lesser Antilles island country in the southern Caribbean Sea and the Dutch Caribbean region , approximately 65 km north of the Venezuelan coast . It is a constituent country ( land ) of the Kingdom of the Netherlands . It was formerly called Curaçao and Dependencies ( 1815 -- 1954 ) and the Country of Curaçao ( Land Curaçao Pais Kòrsou ) ; it includes the main island of Curaçao and the uninhabited island of Klein Curaçao ( `` Little Curaçao '' ) . It has a population of over 150,000 in an area of 444 km2 , and its capital is Willemstad . Before the dissolution of the Netherlands Antilles on 10 October 2010 , Curaçao was administered as the `` Island Territory of Curaçao '' ( Dutch : Eilandgebied Curaçao , Papiamentu : Teritorio Insular di Kòrsou ) , one of five island territories of the former Netherlands Antilles .

[P3] Brievengat
Brievengat ( [ ˈbri.və . ˌɣɑt ] ) is a small town in northeast Curaçao . It is located to the north of the capital , Willemstad , and to the east of the Hato International Airport . Category : Populated places in Curaçao

[P4] Sint Willibrordus
Sint Willibrordus is a small town in Curaçao . It is located close to the west coast , to the northwest of the capital Willemstad , not far from the western end of Bullenbaai . Close to Sint Willibrordus are the beaches of Daaibooi and Playa Porto Marie . Category : Populated places in Curaçao

[P5] Miss International Curaçao
Miss International Curaçao is the national female beauty pageant of Curaçao , along with Miss Curaçao and Señorita Curaçao .
